info.title: MACH VON design API
info.description: Design contract, not deployed. JWT issuer/audience, verified membership, entitlements and action scope checked server-side. Money strings, cursor pagination, immutable revisions, UTC. ETag/If-Match for state changes; idempotency scoped to tenant+subject+operation+key. Non-tenant platform operations use separate audience. Baseline 1.3: explicit SystemAdmin theme workflow. Generic resource contracts remain scaffolding and require action DTO/policy review before implementation.
